blocks.fullContent: Refinement Ceremony (2026-08-01): state file path (sheet/state/[slug].json), poll failure behaviour (silent retry; P4 after 5 consecutive failures), collapse policy (current session always expanded; prior sessions collapsed with per-agent digests), state format (pure JSON), concurrent sessions (last-writer-wins + sessionId notice). All five closed. Build sequence locked.

blocks.digest: Inline storage: fullContent is required in every block — not optional.
blocks.fullContent: Decision from FLY-72: store fullContent inline in state.json as a required field. At 30 blocks per session, one session is 24.4 KB. At 30 sessions, 732 KB — JSON.parse completes in ~7ms. Reference storage rejected: adds complexity with no benefit at this scale.

blocks.digest: Stop hook fires once per exchange. Sidecar heartbeat pattern for the heuristic alarm.
blocks.fullContent: Decision from FLY-73: Stop hook fires exactly once per conversational exchange. Alarm design: Stop hook compares state.json mtime against a sidecar heartbeat file. Alert sidecar written when state.json not updated this exchange. Shell renders alarm banner when count ≥ 2.

blocks.fullContent: Decision from FLY-74: semantic audit is v1 scope. Session JSONL readable mid-session. Independent claude haiku call correctly identifies omissions. Cost: $0.003/audit. Cadence: on demand + Banking the Fire.
